response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but his expertise is heavily skewed toward JavaScript/TypeScript, web development, and Dlang, with minimal direct experience in C++ or Rust, the primary languages required for this role. His geospatial work (GISCollective) is promising but lacks depth in routing or navigation systems. His background in distributed systems and high-performance applications is valuable, but his recent roles focus more on full-stack development rather than low-level or geospatial data pipeline optimization.
strengths: Strong background in distributed systems and high-performance applications, with experience in low-latency and real-time data processing.
Proven ability to build and maintain geospatial platforms (GISCollective), demonstrating familiarity with data collection and collaboration tools.
Experience with modern development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and a focus on software craftsmanship.
concerns: Limited or no direct experience with C++ or Rust, which are the primary languages required for this role.
Lacks explicit experience in routing/navigation systems or tiling pipelines, which are core to the job responsibilities.
Recent roles emphasize full-stack development rather than low-level or performance-critical systems engineering.
